questions.question: Q. What is an operating system (OS)?
questions.answer: An operating system (OS) is software that manages computer hardware and software resources, providing services for computer programs.Acts as an intermediary between users and computer hardware.Manages system resources like CPU, memory, and storage.Examples include Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.Provides a user interface, either command-line or graphical.Handles file management, process management, and security.

questions.question: Q. What is an aging report and how is it used in accounts payable?

questions.question: Q. What is an operating system (OS)?
questions.answer: An operating system (OS) is software that manages computer hardware and software resources, providing services for computer programs.Acts as an intermediary between users and computer hardware.Manages system resources like CPU, memory, and storage.Examples include Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.Provides a user interface, either command-line or graphical.Handles file management, process management, and security.

questions.question: Q. What is an aging report and how is it used in accounts payable?
